title: Summarizer input row
description: One row of the summarizer's input table: one distinct file, or one file kind represented by a sample. Stored as CSV; list-valued cells hold JSON arrays.

unit_id.description: s3:// URI of the file, or of the prefix plus a glob for a file kind

prefix.description: s3:// URI of the prefix the unit sits in

unit.description: file name, or the glob that defines the file kind

file_type.description: lower-case file extension of the sampled file

members.description: number of objects the row stands for

example_keys.description: up to three file names from the unit

excerpt_method.description: how code produced the excerpt, including any truncation

excerpt.description: what code extracted from the sampled file for a model to read

mentions.description: passages from README, Markdown or XML files in this prefix or up to two levels above that name the unit, each prefixed with that file's key
